name: chd13-vo-1
text: This city skipped Sector thirteen... for more than fifty years. Chandigarh. Sector twelve. Then... fourteen. The popular story? Superstition. The planner, Le Corbusier, is said to have seen thirteen as unlucky... and left it out. [pause] Then, in February twenty twenty... Sector thirteen finally appeared. Not new land. An old town on the city's edge, Manimajra, was simply renamed. But the official records tell a quieter story. The land for twelve and thirteen was first marked as a cultural zone... and thirteen just never found its place. So... superstition, or planning? Next time you read the map, count again. Twelve. Thirteen. Fourteen.
